title: Users
intro: Add people, change what they can do, or switch an account off. New people get an email to choose their password.
totalPaged: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · page {page} of {pages}
coursesTaught: {count, plural, one {# course} other {# courses}} taught
addedInvited: Added {count} and emailed them a link to choose a password.
existed: {count, plural, one {# already had an account and wasn't changed.} other {# already had an account and weren't changed.}}
emailFailed: {count, plural, one {# was added but the email didn't send; use "Resend invite".} other {# were added but the email didn't send; use "Resend invite".}}
csvHelp: Save your spreadsheet as CSV. The first row names the columns: email, name and optionally role (student, teacher, parent or admin; student if empty). Up to {max} people at a time.
ready: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} ready to add
readySkipped: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} ready to add, {skipped, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} skipped
linked: Linked {email}. {parent} can now see their progress.
roleChanged: {name} is now {role, select, ADMIN {admin} TEACHER {teacher} STUDENT {student} other {parent}}.
inviteSent: Sent {email} a new link to choose a password.
